data_role: procedural post-v48-freeze cross-database stress test; not pristine external validation because Siena outcomes were historically observed

channels.construction: derive each bipolar channel by subtracting its two canonical referential electrodes
channels.missing_channel_rule: exclude the case; no channel imputation or outcome-dependent remapping

sampling.filter: one-way stateful fourth-order Butterworth SOS bandpass 0.5-45 Hz at 512 Hz
sampling.decimation: causal 4:1 sample selection after the 45-Hz antialias bandpass
sampling.state_carry: only across EDFs whose header timestamps are sample-contiguous
sampling.gap_rule: reset state at every acquisition gap and exclude the next 30 seconds

initialization.window_branch: 2 s if first seizure <20 s; 4 s if 20-75 s; 10 s if >75 s
initialization.normal_history: same v48/CHB rule: use earlier seizure-free EDFs only when at least two exist; otherwise split the first-seizure-record prefix ending 300 s before onset into 2/3 fit and 1/3 calibration
initialization.seizure_phenotype: first independently clinically confirmed seizure; ictal windows only
initialization.later_update: score first, then add ictal windows after event end and independent clinical confirmation
